body.x: NETWORK KOREA (CEO, Shin Dong Hwan) participated in took part in the ‘CES 2017’ held in Las Vegas, the United States from January 5th to January 8th as Daegu Common Facility of Daegu Technopark and displayed ‘IoT Smart Power Strip that is a self power interruption system.

IoT Smart Power Strip saves energy without any special efforts. It interrupts standby power by itself and saves energy, so it is a very comfortable system because users don’t need to use a smart phone and interrupt power.

Also, the users can analyze power usage data of electronics in order to figure out how much power of electronics they use for a month and consider the power efficiency through the system and interrupt or supply power manually or automatically for children safety.

The CEO of NETWORK KOREA, Shin Dong Hwan, said, “We tried to appeal our product’s differentiated part in priority compared to other companies’ products, and consequently, we received a lot of attention from buyers. I hope that this CES would be a great opportunity to extend our business.”

Furthermore, the Daegu Technopark and Smart Venture Institute and Smart Drone Technology Center of Kyungpook National University opened ‘CES Daegu Common Facility’ and supported the exhibition operation of 22 domestic enterprises and business meeting with a buyer.

CES (Consumer Technology Show), which is the world’s largest IT consumer electronics and consumer technology tradeshow, is a good opportunity to figure out the flow of the global electronic industry at a glance and is held on every January by CTA (Consumer Technology Association).

Aving News Korea, which have reported issues of CES, MWC, and IFA as the world’ three major technology exhibitions the most for the last 10 years, will send a special group of reporters to CES, report main issues of the markets, and introduce Korean enterprises all over the world this year.
